articles.title: Allegiant Travel to Buy Sun Country Airlines for About $1.1 Billion
articles.mainIdea: Allegiant Travel to Buy Sun Country Airlines for About $1.1 Billion
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Allegiant Travel to Buy Sun Country Airlines for About $1.1 Billion. Allegiant Travel reached a roughly $1.1 billion deal to buy Sun Country Airlines as budget-focused U.S. airlines struggle with stiff competition from larger rivals. Larger carriers such as United Airlines and Delta Air Lines have deployed their own bare-bones fares to lure bargain hunters while catering to faster-growing demand from well-heeled travelers willing to pay up for extras. Allegiant and Sun Country have been able to steer clear of some of the difficulties that have plagued the low-cost end of the airline industry by being more selective about where and when they fly. Related tickers mentioned: ALGT, DAL.
